actions: email tech@example.com "Japans Theater" Emergency stop activated

triggers.name: Visitor counted (UDP VISITOR)
actions: if var visitors >= 50 then label lbl_show Showstatus: VOL ({visitors})

triggers.name: Door opened (PLC)
actions: if mode Museum is Open then log Door opened during opening hours else email tech@example.com "Door" Door opened outside opening hours

triggers.name: Media server status
actions: if var media_status != {status} then var media_status = {status}

effects.name: XY ripple
effects.code:
// Rings rippling out from a point on the map, like a stone in water
param cx = 0.5 [0, 1]          // centre: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge
param cy = 0.5 [0, 1]          // centre: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge
param speed = 0.5 [0, 3]       // rings per second
param size = 3 [0.5, 10]       // rings from the centre to the edge
param color = #00c7be          // colour of the rings
param back = #000000           // colour between the rings
d = sqrt((x - cx) * (x - cx) + (y - cy) * (y - cy))
k = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin((d * size - t * speed) * tau), 3)
r = mix(back.r, color.r, k)
g = mix(back.g, color.g, k)
b = mix(back.b, color.b, k)

effects.name: Chase
effects.code:
// One light running along the fixtures, in list order
param speed = 1 [0, 8]
param width = 0.25 [0.05, 1]
param color = #ffffff
pos = fract(t * speed / n)
d = abs(fract(u - pos + 0.5) - 0.5) * n
r, g, b = color
dim = smoothstep(width * n, 0, d)

effects.name: Breathe
effects.code:
// Slow fade up and down
param speed = 0.25 [0.02, 2]
param low = 0.1 [0, 1]
param color = #ffb347
r, g, b = color
dim = mix(low, 1, 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(t * speed * tau))

effects.name: Candle
effects.code:
// Warm, gentle flicker
param color = #ff9329
f = noise(t * 2.1 + i * 3.7) * 0.6 + noise(t * 7.3 + i) * 0.4
r, g, b = color
dim = 0.6 + f * 0.4

effects.name: Fire
effects.code:
// Flickering flame, every fixture its own
param speed = 3 [0.5, 10]
f = noise(t * speed + i * 17.3) * 0.7 + noise(t * speed * 2.7 + i * 5.1) * 0.3
r = 1
g = 0.25 + f * 0.35
b = 0
dim = 0.35 + f * 0.65

effects.name: Sparkle
effects.code:
// Random short flashes on a coloured base
param rate = 6 [1, 30]
param chance = 0.08 [0, 0.5]
param base = #1a2a6c
param flash = #ffffff
step_t = floor(t * rate)
on = rand(step_t * 0.37 + i * 0.011) < chance
r = on ? flash.r : base.r
g = on ? flash.g : base.g
b = on ? flash.b : base.b

effects.name: Wave across the map
effects.code:
// Brightness wave moving left to right over the map
param speed = 0.3 [0, 2]
param size = 1.5 [0.2, 6]
param color = #00c7be
r, g, b = color
dim = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin((x * size - t * speed) * tau)

effects.name: Police
effects.code:
// Red / blue alternating halves
param rate = 2 [0.5, 8]
side = u < 0.5
phase = sq(t * rate)
on = side ? phase : 1 - phase
r = on
b = 1 - on
dim = pulse(t * rate * 4, 0.5) * 0.5 + 0.5
